commands.summary: Compute an immutable installation plan. Has no effect of its own.

parameters.name: proposal
parameters.summary: The newly confirmed composition to install.

parameters.name: setup
parameters.summary: An immutable prepared SetupVersion as <stable_id>@<X.Y>.

parameters.name: component
parameters.summary: An exact standalone component as <stable_id>@<X.Y>, repeatable. Installed alongside the named prepared SetupVersion so a managed assignment of loose components can reach a verified baseline; the bundle manifest covers each one.

parameters.name: project
parameters.summary: Local project root that binds a catalogue setup to the current context.

parameters.name: harness
parameters.summary: The harness of the pair, when no proposal or setup names it.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.summary: Provider executable. Omitted, the CLI uses a configured, remembered or managed provider, or acquires the attested OpenNetwork release.

parameters.name: provider-manifest
parameters.summary: Release manifest whose exact artifact is the provider executable. Required by protocol v3 unless unverified-provider is given. A repository pinned for build attestation is verified that way.

parameters.name: provider-build-attestation
parameters.summary: Verify exact provider bytes through the repository, source commit and signer workflow pinned by the local policy. Implied when the manifest repository already has a pinned build-attestation rule.

parameters.name: provider-attestation-bundle
parameters.summary: Optional local GitHub attestation bundle for offline verification.

parameters.name: unverified-provider
parameters.summary: Install from a provider executable no signed or attested release covers, such as one you built yourself. The pinned trust policy checks nothing here, and the plan records provider_release_trusted false.

parameters.name: provider-release-recovery
parameters.summary: Explicitly recover an older exact provider release verified on this machine.

parameters.name: action
parameters.summary: Provider lifecycle action.

parameters.name: protocol-version
parameters.summary: Provider protocol selected before invocation. A trusted release manifest selects it; without one this defaults to frozen v1.

parameters.name: target
parameters.summary: Existing absolute provider target directory. Required by protocol v2/v3.

parameters.name: backup-ref
parameters.summary: Exact provider-owned BackupRef required by a protocol-v3 rollback.

parameters.name: permission-profile
parameters.summary: Provider-declared execution posture, separate from setup identity.

parameters.name: allow-permission
parameters.summary: A permission this target grants the composition, spelled family:value as the component passport declares it, such as process:git or filesystem:.herdr/**. Repeatable. Without a grant the target permits nothing and the plan refuses.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.summary: Projection scope the plan installs into: the harness home (global), the workspace named by --target (project) or the shared ~/.agents root named by --target (user_root). Default global.

commands.summary: The daily state of one project and harness. Reads; never updates anything.

parameters.name: project
parameters.summary: The project passport's stable id.

parameters.name: harness
parameters.summary: The harness of the pair.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.summary: Provider executable, to read the target as it is now.

parameters.name: provider-manifest
parameters.summary: Signed provider release manifest proving these exact bytes. Optional: the release this pair was last verified under is read from the journal when the named executable is its exact bytes.

parameters.name: protocol-version
parameters.summary: Provider protocol selected before invocation. A signed release selects it, named or recorded; without one the read asks in v3, the protocol released providers speak.

parameters.name: unverified-provider
parameters.summary: Read the target through an executable no signed or attested release covers. It does not relax isolation: the read still runs under the launcher its system proved.

parameters.name: target
parameters.summary: Existing absolute provider target directory. Required by protocol v2 and v3.

parameters.name: requires-env
parameters.summary: An additional uppercase variable this target needs beyond its setup passport. Never NAME=value.

parameters.name: catalog-version
parameters.summary: Newest known version, to report catalog drift.
